note: Prompts to check the skills trigger and behave. Run each with and without the plugin and compare. Expectations are what a good answer must do.

evals.prompt: I changed a page in the APEX app source and I want to push it to the dev workspace. Colleagues also edit headings in the browser. How do I deploy?
expectations: exports the live app first and compares it with the source before importing
validates, then imports with set autocommit off from the SQLcl command line
passes the application name (not the connection name) to apex import -name
warns that private saved reports reset on import
checks the APEX and database version first

evals.prompt: I added a page item P7_VIEW and want to show the report region only when it is REPORT. I wrote `item: @P7_VIEW` in the server-side condition and the report never shows.
expectations: explains that the @ makes the item name literal text
gives the fix: item: P7_VIEW without @
shows how to verify the stored condition in apex_application_page_regions

evals.prompt: My team says the new interactive grid page is confusing. It has columns like PROJECT_ID, DEV_ID_FK, PF_LOC_ID and everything is editable. What should I change?
expectations: replaces ids with names or labelled lookups
uses plain headings
locks columns that should not be edited and makes that visible
suggests searchable lists of values and filters with counts
offers a short walk-through test with a new user

evals.prompt: Write a procedure that saves one row edited in an APEX grid: change the parent, but never let a location become its own parent or sit below itself.
expectations: puts the logic in a package with a documented procedure
raises application errors with clear messages for the two rules
does not commit inside the procedure, or says so explicitly
includes audit columns and a runnable test

evals.prompt: We pull records from an external API every night and want to avoid duplicates. How many tables should we use and what should the key be?
expectations: asks to look at real sample data first
proposes a composite natural key and explains it, with virtual columns for nullable parts
stores the raw payload and never silently drops records (side table with a reason, reconciliation)
keeps rules as data and uses normal numeric ids

evals.prompt: Please make sure the new inventory screens and the package behind them are built properly before we release on Sunday.
expectations: exports the live app and runs the scripted checks
runs the schema checks and reads the page as a user
reports findings by severity with evidence and a one-line fix
states what was not checked
